comment.body_excerpt: Another reproduction on **2026.9.9** (single-operator homelab, Gateway on Linux, services behind Tailscale). - Target: Nextcloud OCS API ( ...  a first-class "basic auth" binding: username + secret per host) would cover Nextcloud, WebDAV, git-over-HTTPS and most self-hosted apps.

reasons: Technical reproduction of a Basic authentication secret-substitution failure with a working workaround.
Suggestions directly address the reported project behavior.
